name: manage_navigation
description: Create, inspect, and edit WordPress navigation menus through one consolidated facade. GET is read-only and supports list_locations, list_menus, and read_menu. Use POST for create_menu, add_item, update_item, delete_item, move_item, replace_tree, or assign_location. These writes change WordPress-global navigation immediately and may affect visitors wherever the menu is rendered. They refresh working previews but never rebuild or move the selected Page Builder live artifact. When rendering a specific menu in a wp_menu binding, prefer data-menu-id from list_menus/read_menu; use data-menu-location only for theme-location menus.

parameters.name: operation
parameters.description: Optional navigation action. Omit operation or use list_locations for GET discovery. GET also supports list_menus and read_menu; all create, item mutation, tree replacement, and location assignment operations require POST.

parameters.name: menu_id
parameters.description: Required for operation=read_menu, add_item, update_item, delete_item, move_item, replace_tree, or assign_location. Also use this id as data-menu-id on wp_menu bindings when the user wants this exact menu rendered.

parameters.name: item_id
parameters.description: Required item id for operation=update_item, delete_item, or move_item.

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: Menu item type for add_item or update_item. Allowed: custom, post_type, taxonomy.

parameters.name: object_type
parameters.description: Required for post_type or taxonomy menu items, for example page or category.

parameters.name: object_id
parameters.description: Required object id for post_type or taxonomy menu items.

parameters.name: label
parameters.description: Menu item label for add_item or update_item.

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: Required custom URL for custom menu items.

parameters.name: parent_id
parameters.description: Optional parent item id for add_item or update_item. Required for move_item.

parameters.name: position
parameters.description: Required 1-based sibling position for move_item. Optional per item entry for replace_tree.

parameters.name: classes
parameters.description: Optional CSS classes for add_item or update_item.

parameters.name: items
parameters.description: Full menu item list for operation=replace_tree. Existing menus must include every current item_id.

parameters.name: location_slug
parameters.description: Required theme location slug for operation=assign_location.

output.description: Plain text navigation summary with menu ids, immediate WordPress-global public impact for writes, the unchanged Page Builder live-artifact state, and NEXT STEP guidance. For wp_menu bindings, exact menus should be rendered with data-menu-id.
